note: Pinned independent SDK CI and synthetic-contract snapshot. Checked on 2026-10-15; not a package registry release, certification, or independent security review. Service traceability credits only local tests; SDK tests execute in these workflows.

repositories.workflow:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - name: Verify vendored contracts
        run: python3 scripts/check-contracts.py
      - name: Verify module and formatting
        run: |
          go mod verify
          test -z "$(gofmt -l admin internal oidcclient verifier)"
          go vet ./...
      - name: Unit, negative, concurrency and shared-fixture tests
        run: go test -race -count=1 ./...
      - name: Verifier fuzz smoke
        run: |
          go test ./verifier -run '^$' -fuzz '^FuzzVerify$' -fuzztime 30s
          go test ./verifier -run '^$' -fuzz '^FuzzSenderURLNormalization$' -fuzztime 30s

name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php: ["8.2", "8.5"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962 # v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: openssl, sodium, curl, json
          tools: composer:v2
      - name: Verify vendored contracts
        run: python3 scripts/check-contracts.py
      - name: Package metadata and syntax
        run: |
          composer validate --no-check-publish
          find src tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
      - name: SDK security fixtures and unit tests
        run: php -d error_reporting=-1 -d display_errors=1 tests/run.php
      - name: Verify the documented public VCS consumer
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        env:
          PROUDAUTH_SDK_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          consumer_dir=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$consumer_dir"' EXIT
          python3 - "$consumer_dir" <<'PY'
          import json, os, pathlib, sys
          document = {
              "name": "proudauth/sdk-install-smoke",
              "repositories": [{"type": "vcs", "url": "https://github.com/proudauth/proudauth-sdk-php.git"}],
              "require": {"proudauth/sdk": "dev-main#" + os.environ["PROUDAUTH_SDK_SOURCE_COMMIT"]},
              "config": {"allow-plugins": False}
          }
          pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1], 'composer.json').write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
          composer install --working-dir="$consumer_dir" --no-interaction --no-progress --no-scripts
          php -r 'require $argv[1] . "/vendor/autoload.php"; if (ProudAuth\Sdk\Version::SDK_VERSION !== "0.2.0") { exit(1); } echo "Public VCS consumer installed and autoloaded successfully\n";' "$consumer_dir"

name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-14, windows-2022]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"
      - name: Verify vendored contracts
        run: python scripts/check-contracts.py
      - name: Locked restore
        run: dotnet restore ProudAuth.Sdk.sln --locked-mode
      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build ProudAuth.Sdk.sln -c Release --no-restore
      - name: Execute the SDK test runner
        run: dotnet run --project tests/ProudAuth.Sdk.Tests -c Release --no-build --no-restore
      - name: Formatting and NuGet packages
        run: |
          dotnet format ProudAuth.Sdk.sln --verify-no-changes --no-restore
          dotnet pack ProudAuth.Sdk.sln -c Release -o artifacts --no-build --no-restore
